reviewer.name: Codex
reviewer.method: Interactive source review in this coding session

rubric: Same four binary qualities as the owner packet; pass = no material defect (original 3–4 threshold).
scope: All 30 saved final answers with earlier dialogue, expected behavior, task assertions, saved references and cited evidence. SDK examples checked against saved docs, not live integrations.
not_blinded: This session already contained historical results and known defects. Prior AI reviews and project context can influence this review; it is not an independent blinded study.
limits: AI judgments with inspectable evidence, not human labels or proven ground truth.
Failure-enriched development sample across 11 runtime versions; not current-app accuracy or production prevalence.
No claim that four quality labels re-score every original assertion or integrity gate.
Correctness and grounding can pass for an honest non-answer while completeness fails.
Rubric-sensitive omissions are marked; the frozen checklist can demand more than the literal question.
The configured Llama judge and human agreement remain unmeasured.
Showing this review to the owner makes any subsequent owner review informed by AI, not blinded.
spend_scope: Evaluation API spend only; this interactive coding-session review is not priced in that ledger.
